clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Covers dimensions, quality and strength requirements of lime-pozzolana concrete blocks for use in paving.

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 2. General Requirements —- Shall be sound, free from cracks, broken edges and other defects that would interfere with the proper placing of the unit.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions — 300 mm × 300 mm × 100 mm Note 1—  In view of  low abrasive resistance of lime pozzolana concrete, the blocks shall be provided with a thin wearing course of cement sand mortar of 10 mm  cast integrally with the lime pozzolana concrete. Note 2 — Of the total height of 100 mm, the bottom 90 mm shall consist of lime pozzolana concrete and top 10 mm of  cement sand mortar. SUMMARY OF IS 10360 : 1982 LIME-POZZOLANA CONCRETE BLOCKS FOR PAVING (Second  Revision) Note — For method of tests, refer to  IS 2185 (Part 1): 1997 Concrete masonry units Part 1 Hollow and solid concrete blocks IS 2690 (Part 2):1992 Burnt clay flat terracing  tiles: Part 2 Handmade (second revision), and IS 9284:1979 Method of test for abrasion resistance of concrete, For detailed information, refer to IS 10360:1982 Specification for lime pozzolana concrete blocks for paving.

clauses.title: Drying Shrinkage – Not
clauses.text: 5.2 Drying Shrinkage - Not more than 0.1 percent

clauses.title: Moisture Movement
clauses.text: 5.3 Moisture Movement — Shall not exceed 0.05 percent.

clauses.title: Abrasion Resistance
clauses.text: 5.4 Abrasion Resistance — Of top wearing course surface (1:3 cement, sand mortar) shall have a maximum  abrasion loss of  0.4 percent

clauses.title: Flexural Strength
clauses.text: 5.5 Flexural Strength  — Minimum average modulus of rupture  shall be 0.5 N/mm2.
